entitlement.label: Annual entitlement
entitlement.reportingPeriod: Per year, per Member of Parliament
entitlement.note: Every MP may recommend works up to ₹5 crore each year under the scheme. This is an entitlement to recommend, not money held by the member.

allocatedLimit.label: Allocated limit
allocatedLimit.reportingPeriod: 18th Lok Sabha; dashboard as retrieved (reporting cut-off not supplied)
allocatedLimit.note: The dashboard allocation for this term. Distinct from the annual scheme entitlement and from a release.

released.label: Amount released
released.reportingPeriod: 18th Lok Sabha; dashboard as retrieved (reporting cut-off not supplied)
released.note: Not supplied in the retrieved report. Allocation is not treated as release.

utilization.label: Utilization
utilization.note: Not supplied as a percentage in the retrieved report; not calculated from unlike funding measures.

recommended.label: Amount recommended
recommended.reportingPeriod: 18th Lok Sabha; dashboard as retrieved (reporting cut-off not supplied)
recommended.note: Value of works the member has recommended to the District Authority.

sanctioned.label: Amount sanctioned
sanctioned.reportingPeriod: 18th Lok Sabha; dashboard as retrieved (reporting cut-off not supplied)
sanctioned.note: Value of recommended works the District Authority has approved.

spent.label: Amount spent
spent.reportingPeriod: 18th Lok Sabha; dashboard as retrieved (reporting cut-off not supplied)

balance.label: Amount remaining
balance.reportingPeriod: 18th Lok Sabha; dashboard as retrieved (reporting cut-off not supplied)
balance.note: Unspent balance held with the District Authority, as the report states it. Not computed by us.

schemeNotes: MPLADS money is never held by the Member of Parliament. The member recommends works; the District Authority sanctions them, executes them and reports the expenditure.
Because sanction and execution sit with the district administration, a delay in spending is not by itself attributable to the member, and a completed work is not by itself built by the member.
Funds do not lapse in the way ordinary budget heads do. An unspent balance in one year can be carried into the next, so a low spend figure mid-term is normal.
